turns.replyText:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Getting it right mostly comes down to measuring. Here's the quick playbook for the cellular shades:

Cellular shades (inside mount):



Check your window depth against the "Specifications" tab on the product page first


Width: measure left to right at the top, middle, and bottom, and use the smallest number


Height: measure at the top left, center, and top right down to the sill, and use the largest number


Round odd 1/16" or 1/32" increments down on width, up on height, to the nearest 1/8" 


Don't make your own deductions, we take care of that at the factory



Drapery:



Add 4" to 8" to each side of the window width so panels open fully without blocking glass


Mount the rod 4" to 12" above the window for that taller-ceiling look


Measure from rod placement to where you want the panels to end 



Also, if you want more light coverage on the shades, an outside mount is the better choice, and add at least 4 inches to the width there 
.
